scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplemented by exact symbolic checks. No external certification or independent validation. Does not claim novelty of the ellipsoid-section formula.
scientific_limitations: Applies to five-dimensional axially symmetric ellipsoids with center displacement along their axis and the origin in their interior; no assertion for all ellipsoids or boundary-crossing offsets. Historical priority is not fully resolved.
title: Two exceptional separation-rank collapses for five-dimensional displaced spheroids
